EVOLUTION RESEARCH / 0.4.0

Capability pathways

Six routes from multimodal observations to grounded reasoning and action.

What can an agent learn to do? Follow a capability route, choose an evaluation, then connect it to a method for persistent improvement.

The routes below are editorial research targets inspired by the course. Stage order is not historical ancestry, a required prerequisite sequence, or evidence of recursive self-improvement.

01

CAPABILITY PATHWAY

Grounded perception

↗

Connect observations and instructions to objects, locations, and possible interactions.

  1. Recognize entities
  2. Recover spatial geometry
  3. Represent scene relations
  4. Identify action affordances

Suggested evaluation

Measure referent localization and downstream action success on unseen objects and viewpoints; compare with a 2D-only baseline.

Connect to agent improvement

Store reusable object and affordance knowledge, then test whether that memory transfers to new scenes.

Experience accumulation ↗Harness improvement ↗
Research hypothesis · not a reported result

02

CAPABILITY PATHWAY

Multimodal reasoning

↗

Combine language and sensory evidence when neither alone determines the answer.

  1. Encode modalities
  2. Align meanings
  3. Fuse evidence
  4. Resolve compositional instructions

Suggested evaluation

Test held-out compositions and conflicting inputs. Remove or shuffle each modality to establish whether performance depends on grounding.

Connect to agent improvement

Optimize fusion prompts and evidence-routing code; compare variants under the same model and inference budget.

Iterative optimization ↗Model–harness co-optimization ↗
Research hypothesis · not a reported result

03

CAPABILITY PATHWAY

Generative communication

↗

Produce and iteratively edit visual or spoken outputs under user control.

  1. Interpret intent
  2. Generate visual or audio output
  3. Satisfy structural constraints
  4. Revise through interaction

Suggested evaluation

Under a fixed interaction budget, measure constraint satisfaction and requested-edit success, including preservation of unchanged content.

Connect to agent improvement

Retain useful feedback as edit strategies and test reuse across tasks; distinguish one output revision from a persistent agent update.

Experience accumulation ↗Iterative optimization ↗
Research hypothesis · not a reported result

04

CAPABILITY PATHWAY

Temporal & causal world models

↗

Reason about how a world changes and which actions could produce a desired outcome.

  1. Track events
  2. Predict dynamics
  3. Compare action-conditioned futures
  4. Plan and test interventions

Suggested evaluation

Compare equal-budget planning with and without a predictive model on changed dynamics. Test causal claims on held-out interventions separately from prediction accuracy.

Connect to agent improvement

Use failed rollouts to propose planner changes, retain alternative variants, and test whether archive-guided selection improves later planning.

Archive search & branch evolution ↗Experience accumulation ↗
Research hypothesis · not a reported result

05

CAPABILITY PATHWAY

Embodied action

↗

Turn multimodal understanding into physical actions that adapt to contact and disturbance.

  1. Ground affordances
  2. Represent executable actions
  3. Condition policies on instructions
  4. Correct through sensory feedback

Suggested evaluation

Measure success on unseen objects and perturbations; ablate visual, language, and tactile feedback separately.

Connect to agent improvement

Transfer a learned skill library to new objects or embodiments; test retained task success and adaptation cost.

Experience accumulation ↗Model–harness co-optimization ↗
Research hypothesis · not a reported result

06

CAPABILITY PATHWAY

Structured & scientific reasoning

↗

Work with tables, charts, symbolic relations, and scientific measurements while preserving their structure.

  1. Extract structured observations
  2. Compose relations
  3. Execute explicit reasoning
  4. Test evidence-based hypotheses

Suggested evaluation

Hold out relation compositions or acquisition settings. Measure answer accuracy, structural consistency, and intervention predictions separately.

Connect to agent improvement

Evolve parsers, verifiers, and analysis workflows; test whether improved components transfer to a new domain without changing the evaluation budget.

Harness improvement ↗Archive search & branch evolution ↗
Research hypothesis · not a reported result

Apply across every route

Data, training & evaluation L16 · L17

Hold data access, training resources, and evaluation budgets constant when comparing agent variants.

Human interaction, privacy, safety & alignment L26

Assess permission adherence, privacy, controllability, and user correction across all capability routes.

To test inheritance, transfer a saved component to a new task or descendant and compare against removal or reset. To test lineage-guided search, compare with linear improvement and ordinary archive search under the same budget. To test better improvers, hold the future search budget constant. Higher task scores alone do not answer either question.
